objective: Prove the overlay's own pipeline against the REAL server and the REAL engine. web/test/realServer.e2e.test.tsx already boots python3 -m server (PobCalculator + AssumptionsEvaluator on an ephemeral port) and drives the web app through it, but every overlay test to date -- clipboardPipeline, diffFlow, snapshots, captureLatency -- runs against a stub postDiff or the fixture mock. Nothing has ever shown that the shell's production composition reaches a real engine-computed card. Add overlay/test/realServer.e2e.test.ts: boot the real server exactly as the web e2e does (same construction, same golden corpus PoB code from engine/corpus/seed/ninja/12-elementalist-ci-cold-snap.json, same loud-skip-when-the-runtime-is-absent banner policy -- read that file and copy its lifecycle, do not invent a second one), POST the golden build once through the generated client, then drive the PRODUCTION composition: createClipboardPipeline with the real createDiffFlow and bindGeneratedDiff(resolveServerBaseUrl(env)) pointed at the ephemeral port, with ONLY the clipboard source stubbed (the one seam Electron owns). Feed it engine/tests/fixtures/item.txt through that clipboard seam and assert the ShellState sequence LOADING -> VERDICT, with the VERDICT card schema-valid against contracts/verdict.schema.json and its offense/defense deltas being the engine's real numbers, not a fixture's. Then assert the two honest failure modes on the same real server: a capture BEFORE any build is imported yields ERROR_NO_BUILD, and unreadable text yields ERROR_UNPARSEABLE. Real in-game-format clipboard text is NOT this stage's job -- that seam is issue #119, backend-owned; use the existing golden item so this stage is independent of it, and say so in a comment.
constraints: Test-only stage. overlay/src is not modified: if the production composition cannot be driven without a source change, that is a finding -- report it in the PR and stop, do not reshape src to fit the test.
Only the clipboard source is stubbed. postDiff, diffFlow, the state projection, and the generated client are the real ones; a test that reimplements the pipeline proves nothing.
A missing engine runtime or missing python3/pyyaml must skip LOUDLY with a banner (the web e2e's policy) -- never a silent pass and never a soft assertion.

package.json and vitest.config.ts changes are limited to what the e2e needs (a longer hook timeout, a script entry). No dependency additions beyond a JSON-schema validator already used elsewhere in the repo.
Existing overlay tests may not be deleted, skipped, or edited.

acceptance_criteria.text: overlay/test/realServer.e2e.test.ts boots the real server (python3 -m server construction, ephemeral port) and imports the golden corpus build through the generated client.
The production createClipboardPipeline composition -- real diffFlow, real bindGeneratedDiff, only the clipboard source stubbed -- receives the golden item text and emits LOADING then VERDICT.
The VERDICT card validates against contracts/verdict.schema.json and its deltas come from the engine's response, asserted against the response body rather than a hardcoded fixture card.
Against the same real server: a capture before any build import yields ERROR_NO_BUILD, and unreadable text yields ERROR_UNPARSEABLE.
Absent python3, pyyaml, or the engine runtime the suite skips with a printed banner naming what is missing; it never silently passes.
npm --prefix overlay run test passes (suite plus tsc); overlay/src is unmodified and no existing test was deleted, skipped, or edited.

rollback: git revert the stage commit; one test file and its config entry are removed, no product behavior changes.
